title: Kataib Hezbollah faces deadline to leave Iraqi stronghold
html:
Kataib Hezbollah faces deadline to leave Iraqi stronghold

Iraq’s government has given Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah until today to withdraw from Jurf al-Sakhar, a strategic area south of Baghdad that the group has controlled for more than a decade. Al Jazeera’s Peter Smith reports from the disputed territory.
summary: Kataib Hezbollah faces deadline to leave Iraqi stronghold
